description: Community Attitudes to Road Safety Survey is a report listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Department of Infrastructure, Transport, Regional Development, Communications and the Arts. The Community Attitudes Survey (CAS) ran from 1986-2017 and provides a national snapshot of Australian attitudes, experiences and behaviours regarding road safety topics. It helps evaluate specific road safety measures and suggests new areas for intervention. Coverage is Australia, 1986 to 2017; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as not stated, the status as non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-06-18. Files and pages listed: PDF (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support network flow and freight or traffic assignment models and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
